author: EpochFlame
content: I have a copy of the linker in the include folder and do this

author: EpochFlame
content:
```bat
cd "repo\include"
"repo\tools\mwcc_compiler\2.6\mwcceppc.exe" -Cpp_exceptions off -proc gekko -RTTI off -fp hard -fp_contract on -rostr -O4,p -use_lmw_stmw on -sdata 8 -sdata2 8 -nodefaults -msgstyle gcc -E "%~1" > ctx.c
pause```
